output.why: The technical specification (Clause 7.1.10), P&ID, and Datasheet A explicitly mandate two (1 working + 1 standby) ESP Unit-1 waste water transfer pumps of 50 m3/hr each. Eliminating the standby pump violates the required 1W+1S redundancy.
